title: Rav Huna son of Rav Chiyya
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned in [Avodah Zarah 67b](https://www.sefaria.org/Avodah_Zarah.67b.7), but Hyman says the reading there should be “Chiyya son of Rav Huna,” as in Dikdukei Soferim; and so it is in [Pesachim 44b](https://www.sefaria.org/Pesachim.44b.15).[^1]

notes.text: The two passages give opposite patronymics for the ruling about a pot used that day. Hyman prefers the Pesachim form and reports it from Dikdukei Soferim for Avodah Zarah.
